blurb: Guests can rent new pontoon boats for families and groups up to 10 people, with shade canopies and Maryland fishing licenses included. Pontoon rentals are available in 2, 4, 6, or 8 hour options, with a full tank of gas provided. Jet ski rentals are one hour trips in Assawomen Bay, accompanied by a guide for safety but not a guided tour.
